response.sql: WITH dept_counts AS (SELECT mj.department AS department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member m JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id GROUP BY mj.department), shares AS (SELECT department, member_count, CAST(member_count AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(member_count) FROM dept_counts) AS share FROM dept_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.department, s.member_count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_average FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY s.share DESC

assumptions.assumption: Members whose link_to_major matches a row in major are counted via an inner join; members with NULL or unmatched majors are excluded from both the counts and the total. Departments are grouped by the department name text, so majors in the same department are combined.
The average share is the unweighted mean of the per-department shares (equal to 1 divided by the number of departments), computed only over departments that have at least one member.
